name: Yagami Misako
source:
Misako is [url=https://vndb.org/c60747]Yuusuke[/url]'s father's new wife. Her previous husband died three years prior to the beginning of the game's story. The relationship between Misako and her new husband is nothing more than a marriage of convenience for Yuusuke's father's company and there is no real affection between them. A yearning for something that she couldn't express has freed Misako's forbidden desires, as her relationship with her new step-son started to grow more and more complex.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/921736-gibo-stepmothers-sin/faqs/31321]Geo's Walkthrough[/url]]
